milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the red_glazed_terracotta structure (centered around [10, 0, 10] spawn-relative) and face it. max_distance=16 allows detection from moderate range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a red_bed drops a red_bed item into the player's inventory. Beds can be broken instantly by hand or with any tool. The bed is placed at ~9, 0, 6-7 near the terracotta structure, so the player must first find the terracotta area (dependency). When the bed is broken, it drops as a single 'red_bed' item.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The horse is summoned at [3, 0, 3] spawn-relative with NoAI so it stays in place. The player must navigate near it and face it. max_distance=10 is generous since the horse is relatively close to spawn, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=mob, max_count=0) because this is a kill/combat task. The llama is spawned at [15, 0, 15] with NoAI so it won't wander away. A generous box covering the entire scene (min=[0,-2,0], max=[25,5,25]) ensures the llama stays inside the detection area until actually killed. The player has a diamond_sword to kill it efficiently.
